summary: Iteration 289 — Group role_override Feature Testing Complete. Backend: 8/8 tests passed. Frontend: role_override dropdown verified in GroupsPanel. The feature correctly downgrades user permissions when they are members of groups with role_override set.
critical_code_review_comments: ROLE_OVERRIDE LOGIC: _resolve_from_user in permissions.py correctly uses ROLE_RANK = {guest: 0, member: 1, moderator: 2, admin: 3} and min() to pick lowest role
AUTO-SET FOR GUEST NAMES: Groups with exact names 'Gast', 'Guest', 'Gäste', 'Gaeste', 'Guests' auto-set role_override='guest' on creation
CACHE INVALIDATION: PUT /api/admin/groups correctly invalidates permissions_cache when role_override changes
FRONTEND DROPDOWN: GroupsPanel.js has [data-testid='group-role-override-select'] with options: (keine), Gast, Mitarbeiter, Moderator
IMPORTANT BEHAVIOR: Admin users in Gast-Group ARE downgraded to guest-level caps (min(admin=3, guest=0) = guest). This may be intentional or a design decision to review.
seed_data_creation: Created test groups and users during testing, cleaned up after each test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 289 role_override feature fully tested. Key findings: (1) GET /api/admin/groups returns role_override field, (2) Groups with guest-like names auto-set role_override='guest', (3) PUT updates role_override correctly, (4) PRIMARY TEST PASSED: User with role='member' in Gast-Group gets only guest caps (view:dashboard, view:chat), (5) User in multiple groups with one having role_override='guest' is downgraded (lowest wins), (6) Frontend dropdown works correctly in GroupsPanel edit dialog.

backend_api.test_get_groups_returns_role_override_fi: PASS - GET /api/admin/groups returns role_override field for all groups
backend_api.test_create_group_non_guest_name_no_role: PASS - Non-guest named groups have role_override=None
backend_api.test_update_group_role_override: PASS - PUT updates role_override correctly, invalid values set to None
backend_api.test_member_in_guest_group_gets_only_gue: PASS - Member in Gast-Group has only view:dashboard and view:chat
backend_api.test_admin_in_guest_group_downgrade_beha: PASS - Admin in Gast-Group is downgraded to guest caps (by design)
backend_api.test_member_in_group_without_role_overri: PASS - Member in group without role_override keeps all member caps
backend_api.test_user_in_multiple_groups_lowest_role: PASS - User in multiple groups (one with guest override) is downgraded to guest

frontend_components.dropdown_value_change: PASS - Can select 'guest' option and value updates correctly
frontend_components.gast_group_has_guest_override: PASS - Gast group shows 'Gast (überschreibt höhere Rollen)' selected

design_note: The role_override feature uses 'lowest wins' logic. This means even admin users can be downgraded to guest if they are in a group with role_override='guest'. This is by design per the code comment in permissions.py but may need business review if admins should be exempt from downgrade.
